# CloudCert Lab — Multi-Cloud & AI Certification Exam Simulator (2026–2027)

> Zero-login interactive exam simulator covering 11 official AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud certifications (165 free scenario questions + interactive flashcards + 2,860 Pro Vault scenarios across 44 timed mock exams + Master Exam Hacks Cheat Sheets PDF for $19.99 one-time).

## 2026–2027 Exam Comparison & Migration Guides
- [AWS DVA-C02 vs DVA-C03 (New Dec 2026)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/aws-dva-c02-vs-dva-c03/): Side-by-side comparison of AWS Certified Developer Associate DVA-C02 vs new DVA-C03 (effective Dec 1, 2026): domain weight shifts, Amazon Q Developer, Bedrock Guardrails & Lambda SnapStart.
- [Azure AI-901 vs AWS AIF-C01 vs GCP GenAI Leader](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/ai-certifications-comparison-2026/): Compare the top 3 foundational Cloud & Generative AI certifications of 2026-2027: Microsoft Azure AI-901, AWS AIF-C01, and Google Cloud Generative AI Leader. Difficulty, domains & free practice tests.
- [AWS GenAI Developer Pro (AIP-C01)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/aws-aip-c01-guide/): Complete 2026-2027 study guide for AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Professional (AIP-C01): 5 official domains (31%/26%/20%/12%/11%), Amazon Bedrock RAG, Agents, Guardrails & $300 retake protection.
- [AWS Associate Certs: SAA-C03 vs DVA-C03 vs DEA-C01 vs MLA-C01](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/aws-associate-certifications-comparison-2026/): Compare all 4 AWS Associate certifications in 2026-2027: Solutions Architect (SAA-C03), Developer (DVA-C03 Dec 2026), Data Engineer (DEA-C01) & ML Engineer (MLA-C01). Exam fees, pass bars & free mock tests.
- [Azure AI-900 vs AI-901 (2026 Migration)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/azure-ai-900-vs-ai-901/): Compare retiring Microsoft Azure AI-900 vs new AI-901 (2026-2027): Microsoft Foundry Hubs & Projects, Agentic AI workflows, RAG, Entra ID & 15 free practice questions.
- [AWS CLF-C02 vs AIF-C01 vs SAA-C03](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/aws-clf-c02-vs-aif-c01-vs-saa-c03/): Should you take AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02), AI Practitioner (AIF-C01), or Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) first in 2026-2027? Difficulty, salary ROI & free mock tests.
- [Free 33-Hack Multi-Cloud & AI Exam Cheat Sheet (2026–2027)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/free-cloud-ai-exam-cheat-sheet-2026/): 3 verified Exam Hacks per certification across all 11 exams + passing bars.
- [Cloud & AI Certification Exam Traps Glossary (2026–2027)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/cloud-ai-exam-glossary-2026/): 12 high-yield service comparisons & elimination rules for AWS, Azure AI-901 & GCP.
- [Cloud & AI Exam Costs, Passing Scores & Retake Fees (2026–2027)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/cloud-ai-exam-costs-passing-scores-2026/): Official $99–$300 exam fees, 70%–75% pass bars, retake waiting periods & 50% AWS voucher strategy.
- [2026–2027 Cloud & AI Certification Study Plan Generator & Path Finder](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/cloud-cert-study-plan-generator-2026/): Free 3-click cert recommender and dynamic domain-weighted week-by-week study checklist with Markdown & PDF export for 10 AWS, Azure, and GCP certifications.
- [Microsoft Azure AI-102 vs AI-103 (2026–2027 Migration Guide)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/azure-ai-102-vs-ai-103/): Side-by-side comparison of legacy Azure AI-102 Cognitive Services vs new AI-103 Microsoft Foundry, RAG, Agentic AI & Entra ID zero-trust security.
- [AWS MLA-C01 vs MLA-C02 (2026–2027 Migration Guide)](https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/exams/aws-mla-c01-vs-mla-c02/): Side-by-side comparison of classical SageMaker MLOps (MLA-C01) vs Foundation Models, Amazon Bedrock RAG, Guardrails & Agentic MLOps (MLA-C02).
